---
category: Job board
---
The 1–5 quality grade an admin gives when work passes verification. Pass `onChange` to make it an input; omit it for a read-only display.

The grade feeds the freelancer ranking (70% of the score), so keep the scale meaning stable: 5 shipped as specified with no follow-up, 4 minor polish needed, 3 acceptable with fixes we made ourselves, 2 and 1 should usually be "Request changes" instead.
